Merton is the School of Management Distinguished Professor of Finance at the MIT Sloan School of Management. Merton is University Professor Emeritus at Harvard University and was the George Fisher Baker Professor of Business Administration (1988–98) and the John and Natty McArthur University Professor (1998–2010) at Harvard Business School.
